row.evidence: LinearB's pricing table ticks SCIM and SAML SSO on Essentials ($29/user/month billed annually), but its help centre says "SCIM provisioning is supported only with Okta. Microsoft Entra and Google Workspace do not support SCIM provisioning for LinearB."
row.notes: Status changed from gated to partial. Plans and prices changed since June: Pro ($420/yr) and Enterprise ($549/yr) are replaced by Essentials $29/u/mo (50+ developers) and Enterprise $59/u/mo (100+), billed annually; the pricing page now ticks SAML SSO and SCIM on Essentials, so SCIM is no longer price-gated, but it works only with Okta. The Okta SCIM guides still say "available to Enterprise customers" (conflict). SSO/SCIM must be enabled by LinearB Support. Okta-only scim_ops.update is from the guide (Push Profile Updates).

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: SAML SSO, SCIM, audit log (1 year) and API rows ticked for Essentials in the pricing comparison table (read from page markup, img alt "Included"). Minimum billable users 50; up to 5 admins; GitHub Cloud only.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.price_text: $59 user/month, billed annually (100+ developers); custom plans for large deployments

scim.notes: Pricing page ticks SCIM on Essentials; the Okta SCIM guides say Enterprise (see conflicts). SSO and SCIM must be enabled by LinearB Support.

auth.token_source: Company Settings → API Tokens → Create API Token (sent as HTTP Header in Okta)
auth.notes: Okta "HTTP Header" mode sends the token as a Bearer header; LinearB does not name the scheme.

deprovision.notes: Newer guide says users are deactivated; older guide says "automatically removed from LinearB".

custom.how: userRole (admin/editor/viewer) and scopeTeamIds (number array of team IDs), both in the core User namespace

roles.how: userRole attribute (admin, editor, viewer); default Viewer

limitations.text: SCIM works only with Okta; Microsoft Entra and Google Workspace are not supported.
SSO and SCIM are off by default and must be enabled by LinearB Support.
Disabling SCIM leaves existing users unchanged.

okta.notes: OIN page ticks SAML, SCIM, Create and Deactivate (read from page markup); no Update or Group Push ticked.

entra.notes: No LinearB entry in the Microsoft Learn saas-apps index; LinearB documents Entra SAML and says Entra SCIM is not supported.

google.notes: Custom SAML app in Google Admin; Google SCIM not supported.

onelogin.notes: LinearB lists OneLogin for SAML SSO; SCIM is Okta-only.

jumpcloud.notes: JumpCloud page not found in its sitemap.

conflicts.text: Pricing page ticks SCIM on Essentials ($29); both Okta SCIM guides say SCIM provisioning is available to Enterprise customers.
Auth hub FAQ says SCIM does not assign users to teams; the newer Okta SCIM guide says SCIM can assign teams via scopeTeamIds.
Newer Okta guide says SCIM deactivates users; the older guide says deactivated Okta users are removed from LinearB.

open_questions: Whether SCIM on Essentials is actually sold (pricing table) or Enterprise-only (help guides).
SCIM filtering, pagination, PUT vs PATCH, delete, Groups endpoint and rate limits are not documented.
Whether SCIM deactivation frees the billable seat or ends sessions is not stated.
OneLogin and JumpCloud catalogue status not confirmed.
